body.statement: For every \(i\in I\) and \(j\in J\), \(E_P[Z^{\mathrm{ipw}}_{ij}\mid\mathbb G_{o(i,j)-1}]=M_{ij}\). Hence the row-major sequence \((E_{o^{-1}(k)},\mathbb G_k)_{k=1}^{nm}\) is a matrix martingale-difference array, with conditional variance bounded by a constant times \(B^2/q\) and increment magnitude bounded by a constant times \(B/q\).
body.justification: This identifies the effect matrix and exposes the conditional variance and increment scales needed by rowwise perturbation.
body.gap: Hadad et al. identify scalar adaptive IPW scores, not their rowwise spectral use.
body.consumer: It supplies a correctly scaled effect surface for micro-randomized trials with saved propensities.
